status.$description: Three distinct treatments per role, not one. Solid: <name> fill + text.onBrand (white) — already AA in both themes, white-on-fill doesn't depend on background. Soft: <name>Subtle fill + on<Name> text, no border. Outline: on<Name> text + <name>Border border, on the page background — NOT on the Subtle fill. Border is only verified against bg.page (>=3:1); against its own Subtle fill it's 1.8-2.8:1, which is why outline and soft are two separate treatments rather than one badge that layers both. Do not build an outline-on-Subtle variant.

onNeutral.$description: Foreground on neutralSubtle, or on the page for an outline badge. 4.65:1 on neutralSubtle.
